title: Street Snacks or the Old Town? Walking 2,200-Year-Old Guangzhou | China Travel Expert
description:
Two thousand years before Shanghai's skyline, people were already trading here. Guangzhou grew from Panyu, founded in 214 BC during the Qin conquest of the south — so this street-level walk is through a city that's been doing business for about 2,200 years. It became one of the main departure points of the ancient Maritime Silk Road, with ships bound for Southeast Asia, India and Arabia leaving from the Pearl River as far back as the Han dynasty.

★ Expert Tip: come hungry — Guangzhou is the home of Cantonese breakfast (morning dim sum / 早茶), and the old pedestrian streets are best walked before lunch, when the snack stalls open.

广州（番禺）始建于公元前214年，距今约2200年，是海上丝绸之路的重要始发港之一。先逛小吃，还是先走老城？
